# Neuroscience > Explore neuroscience concepts: brain modeling, neural networks, and cognitive simulations. Includes datasets, tools, and research examples for computational neuroscience. ## Contact With Me:
## Table of Contents - [Introduction](#introduction) - [Programming Tools & Libraries](#programming-tools--libraries) - [Python](#python) - [Matlab](#matlab) - [C++](#c) - [JavaScript](#javascript) - [R](#r) - [Learning Resources](#learning-resources) - [Ebooks & Textbooks](#ebooks--textbooks) - [Blogs](#blogs) - [MOOCs](#moocs) - [Communities](#communities) - [Newsletters](#newsletters) - [Miscellaneous](#miscellaneous) - [Computational Neuroscience Research Labs](#computational-neuroscience-research-labs) - [Europe](#europe) - [Germany: INI (Ruhr-Universität Bochum)](#germany-ini-ruhr-universität-bochum) - [Italy: SISSA (Trieste)](#italy-sissa-trieste) - [Norway: NTNU (Trondheim)](#norway-ntnu-trondheim) - [Switzerland: EPFL (Lausanne)](#switzerland-epfl-lausanne) - [North America](#north-america) - [Canada: University of Waterloo](#canada-university-of-waterloo) - [USA: West Coast](#usa-west-coast) - [USA: Central](#usa-central) - [USA: East Coast](#usa-east-coast) - [License](#license) ## Introduction [Neuroscience](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neuroscience) is the study of how the nervous system develops, its structure, and what it does. Neuroscientists focus on the brain and its impact on behavior and cognitive functions. [Computational neuroscience](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Computational_neuroscience) is a multidisciplinary science that joins biology/neuroscience, medicine, biophysics, psychology, computer science, mathematics, and statistics to study the nervous system using computational approaches. ## Programming Tools & Libraries Software, libraries, and frameworks for development purposes in tracings. | [GitHub](https://github.com/jefferis/nat) | | brainGraph | Performing graph theory analyses of brain MRI data. | [GitHub](https://github.com/cwatson/brainGraph) | ## Learning Resources ### Ebooks & Textbooks - **[Neuroscience Online](http://nba.uth.tmc.edu/neuroscience/m/index.htm)** - Open-access electronic textbook covering neuroscience in depth. (UT Houston) - **[Computational Cognitive Neuroscience](https://grey.colorado.edu/CompCogNeuro/index.php/CCNBook/Main)** - Introduction to biologically based computational models. - **[Neuronal Dynamics](https://neuronaldynamics.epfl.ch)** - Open-access textbook on computational and theoretical neuroscience. (EPFL) - **[Andy's Brain Book](https://andysbrainbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/)** - Companion to Andy's Brain Blog, covering fMRI analysis and neuroimaging tools. - **[NiPraxis](https://textbook.nipraxis.org/intro.html)** - Textbook covering fundamental concepts in neuroimaging analysis. ### Blogs - **[Neuroskeptic](https://www.discovermagazine.com/author/neuroskeptic)** - Critical look at developments in neuroscience, psychiatry, and psychology. (Discover Magazine) - **[The Neurocritic](http://neurocritic.blogspot.in/)** - Critical takes on sensationalistic findings in brain imaging and psychopharmacology. - **[The scicurious brain](https://blogs.scientificamerican.com/scicurious-brain/)** - In-depth analysis of single research papers. (Scientific American) - **[Action Potential](http://blogs.nature.com/actionpotential)** - Forum operated by neuroscience editors at *Nature*. - **[Andy's Brain Blog](https://www.andysbrainblog.com/)** - Collection of articles, tutorials, and videos on neuroimaging tools. ### MOOCs - **[The Fundamentals of Neuroscience](https://www.mcb80x.org/)** (Harvard & edX) - Introductory survey of topics in neuroscience. - **[Introduction to Neuroscience](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/brain-and-cognitive-sciences/9-01-introduction-to-neuroscience-fall-2007/)** (MIT OCW) - Structure and function of the human brain. - **[Computational Neuroscience](https://www.coursera.org/learn/computational-neuroscience)** (Coursera) - Introduction to computational methods for understanding nervous systems. - **[Medical Neuroscience](https://www.coursera.org/learn/medical-neuroscience)** (Coursera) - Functional organization of the human central nervous system. - **[Neuromatch Academy](https://github.com/NeuromatchAcademy/course-content)** - Jupyter notebooks from a summer school in computational neuroscience. ### Communities - **[Quora: Neuroscience](https://www.quora.com/topic/Neuroscience-1)** - Answers to questions ranging from basic to advanced. - **[Reddit Neuroscience Link Tables](https://www.reddit.com/r/ScienceNetwork/comments/ptye0/link_tables/)** - List of neuroscience, psychology, and cognitive science subreddits. - **[StackExchange: Psychology & Neuroscience](https://psychology.stackexchange.com)** - Q&A site for the fields. - **[neuroimaging@python.org](https://mail.python.org/mailman/listinfo/neuroimaging)** - Mailing list for discussion of neuroimaging analysis in Python. ### Newsletters - **[On The Brain](http://neuro.hms.harvard.edu/harvard-mahoney-neuroscience-institute/hmni-newsletter)** - Harvard Mahoney Neuroscience Institute's quarterly e-newsletter. - **[Comp-neuro](http://www.tnb.ua.ac.be/mailman/listinfo/comp-neuro)** - Mailing list for the general field of computational neuroscience. - **[BrainPost](https://www.brainpost.co/)** - Weekly easy-to-read summaries of the latest neuroscience publications. ### Miscellaneous - **[Awesome Public Datasets - Neuroscience](https://github.com/awesomedata/awesome-public-datasets#neuroscience)** - High-quality open neuroscience datasets. - **[McCulloch & Pitts Neural Net Simulator](https://justinmeiners.github.io/neural-nets-sim/)** - Simulator for a historical computational model based on neurons. - **[ModelDB](https://senselab.med.yale.edu/ModelDB/default.cshtml)** - Searchable database for computational neuroscience models. - **[NeuronDB](https://senselab.med.yale.edu/NeuronDB)** - Database of neuronal properties. - **[NeuroElectro](https://neuroelectro.org/)** - Searchable database of neuron electrophysiological properties. - **[Neuroscience Mindmap](https://learn-anything.xyz/neuroscience)** - Curated resources for learning neuroscience. - **[neuroSummerSchools](https://github.com/PhABC/neuroSummerSchools)** - List of summer schools in neuroscience and related fields. - **[Brain Matters](https://brainpodcast.com/)** - Neuroscience podcast. - **[NeuroHackademy](https://neurohackademy.org/course_type/lectures/)** - Summer school lectures in neuroimaging and data science. (YouTube) - **[SORTED](https://github.com/PTDZ/SORTED)** - A list of interesting science ideas and links (cognitive/neuro & data science). ## Computational Neuroscience Research Labs This section lists research groups and Principal Investigators (PIs) in computational and theoretical neuroscience.
